decisions.statement: A subagent runs inside the client that launched it.
A client spawned in place of an earlier client runs no subagent already open.
A subagent whose last record predates its client's start is therefore no longer running.
When a client started is the time the folder that client has under /proc carries.
When a subagent last acted is the time that subagent's own transcript carries.
A subagent's transcript sits under the seat transcript's own name beside it.
No span of time is read here.
The order of two moments is read here.
A client whose start cannot be read leaves every subagent judged elsewhere.
A subagent whose transcript cannot be read is left judged elsewhere.
A record written as the client started is read as the client's own.

definition: the subagents whose last record predates the start of the client hosting them
